purpose: Omnira's own governed-effect proof. Exercises the effectful execution path end to end without a provider, a credential or a product side effect.

canonical.what_this_is: A capability test for the execution machinery, not a product process.
canonical.not_a_release: This definition owns no release, no month and no artefact. It can advance nothing in any product workflow.
canonical.why_it_is_separate: Proving that Omnira can govern an irreversible act must not require a Familje-Stunden state to become live. Same reasoning as omnira.release-gate-proof.
canonical.instance_key_is_free_text: The key names a proof scenario, never a month. This definition has no calendar.
canonical.spends_nothing: The only enabled handler computes a deterministic fake cost and performs no network call.

hard_gates.rule: The proof action must never reach a provider, a credential or a product system.
This definition may not be used to advance any Familje-Stunden state.

never_auto.note: Requires a human decision before any retry. The effect state uses this.

states.description: Perform one governed effectful action under full policy: authorization, spend reservation, pre-dispatch revalidation, dispatch certainty and reconciliation.
automated_actions: Perform one deterministic governed effect and record what actually happened.
states.notes: No human gate: the action is deterministic and touches nothing. The governance it exercises is real; the effect is not.
